source: engineering HIL accuracy requirements, not observed holdout results

space_heating_suite.scored_samples: target rows from WARMUP_STEPS onward, excluding ww>=0.5 and all DHW plunge windows

mean_episode_rmse_c.description: unweighted mean of the per-episode causal RMSE values

pooled_rmse_c.description: RMSE over the concatenation of all scored samples

mean_episode_mae_c.description: unweighted mean of the per-episode causal MAE values

min_episode_r2.description: every individual space-heating episode must exceed this R2

dhw_suite.plunge_window_definition: for every ww falling edge (ww 1->0) whose preceding ww-on interval is at least 600 s, score [edge, edge+600 s] at the 10 s grid; score the union if there are multiple such edges

plunge_rmse_c.description: RMSE only inside the explicitly defined DHW plunge windows

min_episode_r2.description: per-episode R2 on the same plunge windows

notes: Thresholds are frozen before the first holdout run and must not be edited afterwards.
Observed VAL-1..VAL-7 episodes are not part of sign-off.
A margin smaller than 1% of the threshold is labelled marginal in the report.
Any FAIL is reported as FAIL; no post-hoc retuning on holdout data is permitted.
